original.target_description: Single fMRI study: bilateral amygdala BOLD activity, second-level analysis using overlapping extremity/fit voxels; interaction between scanning condition (positive versus negative) and stimulus valence (independent postscan positivity versus negativity ratings), F(1, 11).

n.sample_role: Participants retained for the within-participant fMRI analyses, including the target second-level interaction.
n.exclusions: Sixteen enrolled; two excluded for head motion greater than 2 mm in any direction, and two for knowing less than 75% of names. Unknown names were modeled separately; analyses used known names (91% on average).
n.location: Published article p. 153 (PDF page 2), Method, Participants; known-name restriction p. 154 (PDF page 3), Results.

es.location: Published article p. 156 (PDF page 5), Results, Separating Positive and Negative Aspects, interaction paragraph referring to Figure 3.

p.location: Published article p. 156 (PDF page 5), Results, Separating Positive and Negative Aspects, interaction paragraph referring to Figure 3.

replication.target_description: Author-provided OSF replication report, page 6, Effect of Interest: condition (positive/negative) by rating type (positive/negative) interaction in extracted left-amygdala ROI betas. This is a report of the named replication, but equivalence to the supplied 2017 journal version could not be established.

n.sample_role: Participants with complete data in OSF replication report; interaction F denominator df 22.
n.exclusions: Report lists movement exclusions n=10, unknown-name exclusions n=0, MRI contraindication n=1, non-compliance n=1. Starting total 39 and stated final 23 are not reconciled by these listed exclusions. One functional block omitted for two participants and two blocks for one participant due to collinearity.
n.location: OSF replication report, PDF p. 5, Final sample; p. 6, Effect of Interest
n.quote: The final sample consisted of 23 participants with complete data.

es.location: OSF replication report, PDF p. 6, Effect of Interest

p.location: OSF replication report, PDF p. 6, Effect of Interest

reported_success.location: OSF replication report, PDF p. 6, Discussion
reported_success.quote: This study successfully reproduced the effect originally reported by Cunningham et al., (2008)

notes:
Original DOI landing page and UNL full-text download returned 403 challenges; OpenAlex supplied no open full text; Unpaywall request was rejected; CiteSeer PDF route returned 404. Original full text not acquired, and statistics quoted secondhand in the replication report were not substituted for direct original extraction. Replication DOI landing page returned 403; Denver repository explicitly has no full text. Author OSF project bifc7 supplies a complete replication report with the effect of interest on PDF page 6, matching the supplied page locator. It is not the 2017 journal PDF; target_match remains unknown rather than assuming identical journal-version sample or test. No conversions performed.
Source follow-up: Original-only fresh blind extraction. Supplied published article Affective Flexibility: Evaluative Processing Goals Shape Amygdala Activity, Cunningham, Van Bavel, and Johnsen (2008), rather than a manuscript/proof/supplement; title and authors verified on rendered PDF page 1. Locator p. 5 interpreted as PDF page 5 (printed page 156); the focal scanning-condition-by-stimulus-valence interaction linked to Figure 3 was selected. The input supplies no narrower outcome description; other regional tests also occur on this page. Rendered PDF page 5 confirms F(1, 11) = 9.67 and p < .01; rendered PDF page 2 confirms retained sample and exclusions. Canonical text renders the equals sign as digit 5 and the subscripted p-rep label as prep; exact quote glyphs retained, numerical meanings verified visually. No metric conversion. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders, not acquisition failures.
